use_cases: Interactive text reveals on hover for hero section headlines
Animated button text with cursor-following gradient effect
Navigation menu items with dynamic color transitions
Call-to-action text with premium hover feedback
Product headings with engaging visual effects
ai_summary: A cursor-tracking text hover effect that reveals a vibrant multi-color gradient as users move their mouse over text. Built with SVG masks and motion animations, it creates a smooth radial reveal that follows the cursor position, making static text elements feel interactive and dynamic for modern web interfaces.
